symptoms: Focal neurological deficit of sudden onset (hemiparesis, facial droop, speech impairment, ataxia)

management_steps.details: Urgent non-contrast CT Brain, ECG, Blood gas, NIHSS score evaluation.
Indications: Onset < 3 hours, NIHSS > 6, BP < 185/110 mmHg. Administer IV Alteplase per stroke thrombolysis protocol.

management_steps.action: Management of Symptomatic Intracranial Bleeding Post-Thrombolysis
management_steps.details: Stop Alteplase infusion immediately. Urgent STAT non-contrast CT Brain. Transfuse Cryoprecipitate 10 U/kg over 10-30 min. Administer Tranexamic Acid 1g IV over 10 min.

warnings: Strict blood pressure threshold required: SBP < 185 mmHg and DBP < 110 mmHg prior to thrombolysis.
